segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Morning, everyone. Did anyone catch the game last night?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: I did. That last-minute goal was unbelievable.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: I missed it, I was stuck repainting my kitchen all evening.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Okay, let's get going. Today is the booth for the Berlin trade fair.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: First the venue. Last week we agreed to book the small booth in Hall 3.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Right, Hall 3, the twelve square meter one.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: The problem is our new demo wall doesn't fit in twelve square meters.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: How much bigger do we need?

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Eighteen square meters would work. Hall 5 has one left.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Hall 5 is pricier. The quote is 14,500 euros versus 11,800 for Hall 3.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Okay. Let's drop Hall 3 and go with the eighteen square meter booth in Hall 5.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Fine by me, the budget covers it.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Great, the demo wall fits there.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Raj, can you send the deposit?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yes. The deposit is thirty percent, so 4,350 euros. I'll wire it by Friday the 14th.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Registration for exhibitors closes on the 21st, so the 14th gives us a week of slack.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Lena, the booth graphics?

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: I'll send the final print files to the printer by Wednesday the 12th.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: The printer's contact is orders@printhaus.de, copy me on that email please.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: One more thing. Maybe we could also sponsor the evening reception at some point, if there's money left.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hmm, possibly. Let's not get into that today.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Do we know yet whether the fair provides power outlets at the booth, or do we rent them?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Good question. Nobody's confirmed that yet.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: And who's staffing the booth on day one?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: That's me and Lena on day one. Raj covers day two.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: For brochures, the printer suggested five thousand copies.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: That's way too many. Last year we brought back half of the 800 we printed.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Let's print 500 this time.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Okay, 500 copies.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Great, that's it. Thanks, all.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Thanks. Oh, and the coffee machine on the third floor is fixed, finally.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Finally! I'll grab one on my way out.
